SCL_Corpse
Nimias, named in-game as Corpse, is a body which can be found in the Mind Flayer Colony morgue during Act Two.

Involvemernt

Act Two

The mechanical device at the back of the morgue controls the pipe that transports corpses. If a party member interacts with it, Nimias' corpse drops from the cleansing chute.

Speak with Dead

Nimias' corpse can be communed with using  Speak with Dead.

  • Who are you?
    • Corpse
      Nimias... True Soul...
  • Before the Absolute - who were you?
    • Corpse
      Nimias... schoolteacher...
  • What happened to you?
    • Corpse
      Altar... rooftop... my reward...
      • Your reward for what?
        • Corpse
          ...I brought... converts... young souls... for the Absolute...
          • And what was this reward?
            • Corpse
              To see Her design... to see... HER...
              • You saw the Absolute? Tell me what She looked like.
                • Corpse
                  She was... IT was... wrong... No... NO!
  • Where did you come from?
    • Corpse
      Elturgard... She spoke... in my dreams...
  • What were your final thoughts?
    • Corpse
      Mother... would be... proud...

Notes

  • According to dialogue files, Nimias is a fallback corpse which only appears when another minor character fails to end up dead in the chute.
